query:
UPDATE grocery_list_members SET
                    version = v.version,
                    is_deleted = v.is_deleted,
                    sync_state = 'SYNCED',
                    updated_at = $4,
                    updated_by_client = $5
                FROM UNNEST($1::text[], $2::int4[], $3::bool[]) AS v(id, version, is_deleted)
                WHERE grocery_list_members.id = v.id
